question: Pandit Janki Prasad was associated with which of the following Gharanas of Kathak?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banaras**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pandit Janki Prasad** was associated with the **Banaras Gharana** of Kathak.
 
• The **Banaras Gharana**, also known as the Varanasi Gharana, is one of the three main Gharanas of Kathak dance.
 
• This Gharana is known for its intricate footwork, graceful movements, and expressive storytelling.&
